in_marathi.name: Pushkara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pushkara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is born in the lotus. This name represents the divine blessing of being born in a pure and sacred environment, symbolized by the lotus flower.

in_bengali.name: Pushkara
